code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, pancytopenia (low leukocytes, neutrophils, lymphocytes, platelets), elevated RDW, and abnormal differential with monocytosis and basophilia. There is also hypoalbuminemia, low total protein, elevated ferritin, LDH, alkaline phosphatase, and INR. These findings suggest possible bone marrow dysfunction or infiltration, severe infection/inflammation, or hematologic malignancy. Immediate clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are strongly recommended.
